login_hint: Scan with WeChat and confirm in the mini program. First-time users get an account automatically
confirm_in_mini: Tap Confirm in the mini program on your phone
use_password: Existing users: sign in with password
password_tip: After signing in with a password you will need to bind WeChat; afterwards only WeChat sign-in works
bind_desc: To protect your account this site now signs in with WeChat. Scan with your own WeChat to bind it; afterwards this account signs in only through that WeChat and the old password stops working.
bind_hint: Scan with WeChat and confirm binding in the mini program
bind_warning: One WeChat can bind only one account. Use your own WeChat.
unbind_success: Unbound. The user can sign in with the password once to bind again
